headline: A common replay harness that scores any policy in $ and calls per task (cumulative-context cost model, 90% task-clustered CIs); exact parity with `adage eval replay-savings`, calibrated on the live U11 mechanism (1.40 predicted vs 1.85 live, inside CI), $ model reproduces billed cost on 519/519 sessions; whole-session effects remain unvalidated, so levers need a <=$6 live micro-slice.
metric_name: $ saved per task (API-list, cumulative-context model) and tool calls saved per task, held-out control sessions; pass rate as a worst-case non-inferiority bound

held_out.example_policy: U11 post-hoc (as live), 82 Haiku v2 held-out control sessions, 30 tasks

leave_one_repo_out.policy: U11 predictive learner, Haiku v1+v2 (158 sessions, 38 tasks)

cost_model.note: the slope includes the extra output and reasoning longer sessions carry; the model's removal value is the carried context only, so it should be at or below the slope

micro_slice_power.note: local outcome (recovery calls), one-sided alpha 0.05, power 80%

vs_baseline: Reproduces the current state exactly: U11 post-hoc +1.00 calls/session (Rust +1.00), pre-emptive +2.08 (hindsight; Rust +2.11 incl. no misfire charge) / +2.03 predictive. In the target metrics that is +1.9% of $ post-hoc and +3.9% pre-emptive per task.
hard_coded_parts: features.py: line-for-line port of the Rust replay's hand-written Sat/W taxonomy (runner spellings, env-signature/probe/discovery regexes, tool names) - a measurement instrument only
policies/u11.py: the U11 instinct's triggers read from the live bound index plus a hand-written runner-spelling parser (baseline to beat)
replay.py 'read_files' class (search tools and commands) - uncalibrated instrument
defaults p_follow=1.0 (live U11 41/41) and misfire=2 calls (the learner's prior)

ceiling.note: oracle: delete a whole class of calls, perfect follow, no cost, 82 Haiku v2 held-out sessions

build_recommendation: (1) Price 1-hour cache writes at 2x input in pricing.toml/ledger (Claude Code writes them; every Adage $ figure is ~12% low today). (2) Report replay-savings $ under the cumulative-context model (costmodel.py, ~60 lines) instead of a flat $/call. (3) Ship U11 as a predictive PreToolUse rewrite: +2.03 calls, +3.9% of $ per task vs +1.00/+1.9% post-hoc, no hindsight needed. (4) Gate every lever on the <=$6 live micro-slice protocol (10 task pairs; MDE 1.6 local calls) before Rust work: replay is calibrated only for local runner-class effects.
so_what: The harness predicts a runner-class directive's local effect within live CI; it cannot see pass-rate gains or compensation, and whole-session live A/Bs at n~66 pairs cannot resolve effects under ~3 calls. Levers skipping a class of wasted calls are capped at ~10-15% of $ even as oracles, below the North star's 15-20%.
